zh: 修正產品比較逐題填寫時的輸入法狀態問題：前一題「本金」使用數字鍵盤後，下一題「收益參數」現在會強制建立新的文字輸入連線，不再沿用數字鍵盤。`年化6.5%`、`第11年總值41.8萬`、`每年租金36萬 + 樓價年升2%` 等中文／口語收益描述可直接輸入。
補上所有智能計算器問題定義的輸入型別審查：凡是文字、名稱、逐年表或口語參數都必須走文字輸入；純數字題才允許套用數字鍵盤與千分位 formatter，避免再出現「示例寫中文、正式欄位只能輸數字」。
主頁改為分類導航，不再把住房、收支、日常、健康、換算、投資理財、港澳台等全部板塊一次垂直鋪滿。分類導航移到首頁提示後方，選擇分類後只顯示該類工具，手機主頁大幅縮短。
手機首頁工具卡改為兩欄緊湊布局；「開支覆蓋」在「投資 · 理財」分類內提前到退休規劃旁邊，390×844 手機可由分類導航快速進入，不再需要一路滑到首頁最底。
新增真實 UI 回歸：覆蓋「本金數字題 → 中文收益參數題」鍵盤切換，以及「主頁 → 投資理財 → 開支覆蓋」導航。完整 Flutter 回歸擴充至 126 項並全部通過，Web Release 構建成功。
en: Fixed product-comparison input mode switching. After a numeric principal question, the following return-parameter question now rebuilds its text input connection instead of inheriting the numeric IME. Natural-language entries such as `6.5% annual return`, `year-11 value 418k`, and Chinese rental/value-growth descriptions can be typed normally.

Added a schema-wide input-type regression for every Smart Calculator question. Names, tables and natural-language parameters must use text input; only genuinely numeric fields may use the numeric keyboard and thousand-separator formatter.

Reworked the home screen into category navigation instead of rendering every calculator section in one long vertical page. The category selector now appears immediately after the home tip and only the selected category is shown.

Mobile calculator cards now use a compact two-column layout. Expense Coverage was moved earlier within Investing, next to retirement planning, so it is reachable quickly on a 390×844 screen instead of sitting near the bottom of the full home page.

Added real UI regressions for numeric-to-text question switching and Home → Investing → Expense Coverage navigation. The full Flutter regression suite now has 126 passing tests and the Web release build succeeds.
